title: Learning Probabilistic Filters with Strictly Proper Scoring Rules
summary: Bayesian filtering of partially and noisily observed dynamical systems seeks to infer the evolving conditional distribution of the state of a dynamical system given observations, in an online fashion. This Bayesian filtering distribution is rarely available as a supervised learning target. However, one can often use the forecast model to generate synthetic trajectories, with corresponding synthetic observations.
